comment: Index order is not panel order here: the Level jack for each half sits above its V/Oct jack, so the top jack of the upper pair is input 1 and the one below it is input 0. Nothing in this module's own source reads its jacks; src/Flick.cpp:73-78 reaches into them through getLeftExpander(). The level is not clamped, so a negative voltage inverts that half's output.
